notes.title: BUGS PATCHED!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who contributed to finding those sneaky bugs. We've resolved most of the issues reported thus far and improved the experience in the process! Feel free to reach out to us if you have any problems or suggestions, we'll try to respond promptly and we do try to implement most of the feedback into the game.


- Sinn
